budget.derivation: cmp $0x1,%sil; sbb gives -1 for sil == 0 and 0 otherwise; and $0x1ea then add $0xa gives 500 vs 10; the second sbb/and $0xa21fe80/add $0x989680 gives 180000000 vs 10000000
budget.rule: allowed = min(cap_ns, (counter_hi - counter_lo) * per_unit_ns) when counter_lo < counter_hi, else allowed = cap_ns; all arithmetic is unsigned 64-bit

caller_flag.rule: both new callers pass the inverted low bit of their own flag argument (xor $0x1,%edx; movzbl %dl,%esi), so their flag 1 selects the fast budget and their flag 0 selects the slow budget

progress.produced_value: the second slot +0x98 call's return is stored at counter_hi and at snapshot+0x130 via 0x5eee560
progress.rule: after the slot call returns value V, delta = V - counter_hi (unsigned); when delta < allowed, store V at counter_lo and fill the snapshot; otherwise bump the no-progress counter at snapshot+0x124 and publish the existing snapshot

end.rule: on edx 0 stores the global at 0x64cc428 into *(rdi); on 1 stores rsi; on 2 stores *(rsi); otherwise returns 0

snapshot.body: snapshot+0x40..snapshot+0x138 is zeroed by the filler (copied from a zeroed stack scratch), except +0x120 (sequence) and +0x128 (chain head), which are written after the copy

fields.+0x00: slot +0x70 chain result (first non-identity link's slot, else the identity 0x5d2efc0 tail)

fields.+0x124: no-progress counter, incremented by 1 when the progress check fails
